request.subject: OVERLAY:ICEBOUND

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: seen straight from the front, flat, with no floor, no ground and no perspective, the one shape centred on a transparent background, filling most of the square with a small margin, nothing cropped.

Class: one bold chunky board overlay sprite for a turn-based strategy game map, a single low wide heap of sea ice with a big simple jagged silhouette, thick single-colour black outline, big simple shapes and flat colours with one shadow tone, very few details; it must read at a glance at 40 pixels. Colours: pale blue-white ice with light ice-blue shading and a few white highlights, nothing else. The ice floats alone on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn behind or under it, no water and no ship.

layers.text: Subject: one low wide heap of jagged pack ice seen from the front, like the ice that grips the foot of a ship frozen into the sea: a row of chunky pointed ice shards and broken ice blocks side by side, taller at the left and right ends and lower in the middle, about three times as wide as it is tall, flat along its bottom; ice only.
